title: Xiaomi MiMo V2.6 is out — Pro, Flash, and a 20x UltraSpeed tier
body: MiMo-V2.6-Pro and -Flash are natively multimodal at a 1M-token context, built on large-scale RL, at the same rates as V2.5. Pro also gains an UltraSpeed mode worth up to 20x the speed. V2.5 stays live at the same prices until 2026-10-21.
